SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW tbl_x AS VALUES
READ	SELECT STRUCT('alpha', 'beta') ST
READ	SELECT STRUCT('alpha' AS A, 'beta' AS B) ST
READ	SELECT ID, STRUCT(ST.*) NST FROM tbl_x
READ	SELECT ID, STRUCT(ST.*,CAST(ID AS STRING) AS E) NST FROM tbl_x
READ	SELECT ID, STRUCT(CAST(ID AS STRING) AS AA, ST.*) NST FROM tbl_x
READ	SELECT ID, STRUCT(ST.*).C NST FROM tbl_x
READ	SELECT ID, STRUCT(ST.C, ST.D).D NST FROM tbl_x
READ	SELECT ID, STRUCT(ST.C as STC, ST.D as STD).STD FROM tbl_x
READ	SELECT STRUCT(1 AS a) AS b, b AS c
READ	SELECT STRUCT(col1 AS a) AS b, b AS c FROM VALUES(1)
READ	SELECT STRUCT(1 AS a) AS b, b AS c GROUP BY b
READ	SELECT STRUCT(col1 AS a) AS b, b AS c FROM VALUES(1) GROUP BY b
READ	SELECT MAX(STRUCT(1 AS a)), 2 AS b, b AS c GROUP BY b
